list.heading: Jobs
list.description: The durable jobs the connected Core reports. The list is served and paginated by the Core; this surface shows only what the Core returns and invents no rows, counts, or totals.
list.emptyAll: No jobs exist in the connected Core yet.
list.emptyAllBody: Jobs appear here after work is submitted through the Run path. This surface never fabricates a job to fill the list.
list.emptyFilteredBody: The Core returned no jobs for the selected status. Clear the filter to see every job the Core returns.
list.failureTitle: The Jobs list could not be loaded
list.failureBody: The Core refused the list read. The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier; the reference is the safe correlation ID for diagnostics.
list.unknownTitle: The Jobs list could not be confirmed
list.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the list read. Nothing is known about the list until a read is confirmed — this is never shown as an empty list.
list.connectionHint: If no Core session is established yet, connect from the first-run setup with a one-time bootstrap credential.

detail.failureTitle: The job detail could not be loaded
detail.failureBody: The Core refused the job read: the job may not exist for this session, or the read was denied. The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier.
detail.unknownTitle: The job detail could not be confirmed
detail.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the job read. Nothing about this job is known until a read is confirmed. Job identity is stable across connection switches; this surface shows only what the connected Core returns.

attempt.noAttempt: No attempt has been recorded for this job yet.

events.empty: The Core returned no events for this job.
events.projectionNote: Events render what the Core returned. The authoritative job state above — never the event stream — is the source of truth; events never confirm a command outcome by themselves.
events.failureTitle: The event list could not be loaded
events.failureBody: The Core refused the event read. Events render only what the Core returns.
events.unknownTitle: The event list could not be confirmed
events.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the event read. The authoritative job state above stays the source of truth.
events.noPayload: This event carries no inline payload.

result.notLoaded: The result is not loaded. Results are fetched only on request, so a large output is never fetched unbounded.
result.empty: The Core returned an empty result body.
result.failureTitle: The result could not be loaded
result.failureBody: The Core refused the result read: the result may not exist until the job reaches a terminal state, or the read was denied.
result.unknownTitle: The result could not be confirmed
result.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the result read.

cancel.dialogBody: This requests cancellation of job {{jobId}}. The Core records the request; the job is shown as Cancelled only after the Core's authoritative state confirms it — never from this click alone. Escape and leaving this page never cancel a job.
cancel.accepted: The Core accepted the cancellation request (accepted for processing, not confirmation). The authoritative state is re-checked below.
cancel.refusedTitle: The Core refused the cancellation request
cancel.refusedBody: The code below is the Core's stable machine identifier; the reference is the safe correlation ID for diagnostics.
cancel.unknownTitle: The cancellation outcome is not known
cancel.unknownBody: No confirmed response arrived for the cancellation request. A lost response is never proof that the job was cancelled or that it was not. Check the authoritative state before requesting cancellation again — this surface never retries on its own.
cancel.notOffered: Cancellation is offered only while the Core's authoritative state accepts it (queued, running, or waiting).

approvalWaiting.body: This job is waiting for an approval decision. No approval action exists in this surface: accepting or rejecting an approval is a separately tracked capability that is not delivered here, so nothing is offered — the job simply waits until the Core moves it.
